==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

[[Selene]] says they must kill all of the ''[[grolm]]'' or go elsewhere and urges Rand to head to the [[Portal Stone]]. Rand is stubborn and decides to fight. Rand embraces the [[Void]] and looses arrows at the ''grolm'', managing to kill all five of them. He feels the allure of ''[[saidin]]'' while in the Void, the desire to hold it and feel truly alive. Selene looks as though she is not affected by the ''grolm''<nowiki/>'s presence. More ''grolm'' appear and Selene points out that he will run out of arrows. Rand finally allows her to lead them to the Portal Stone. Selene points out which symbol on the Stone is used to return to their world and has Rand [[One Power|channel]] while touching it.

The world flickers many times and they finally get out of the [[Mirror World]], and [[Loial]] says they are in [[Kinslayer's Dagger]]. Rand is tempted to kiss Selene but only tells her to keep the Portal Stone a secret. Selene tells them they are probably ahead of [[Fain]] and the [[Trolloc]]s, since time or distance can move differently in the Mirror World. Selene wants to stay with them a few more days, to see if they can get the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]]. Rand reflects that [[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] would never say he was wise, like Selene did. [[Hurin]] goes to find a camp where they can watch for the Horn. They make sure not to sleep next to any Portal Stones.
